column4: S4.10: the exe's static CRT allocator (operator new rva 0xa57f1, operatorDelete_4a4ffc rva 0xa4ffc) has no port model. Under the replay host both are served by the host's heap (the fixture's heap stand-in), counted apart (CRT_HOST in port/test/audio_stream.py) and not treated as pending rows. Without a host, exe_new carves blocks from an arena the module maps at 0xFE000000 (1 MB) and exe_delete has no effect (a block is never reused). The arena address is a port choice, not a fact of the original; the segments never allocate (0 heap_allocs in all 205 runs: g_soundReady = 0), the device-present run makes 219 allocations in loadSoundTable.
column5: When a port module owns the exe's CRT heap (S4.11's audio_crt covers sound.dll's), route exe_new / exe_delete to it.

column4: S4.10: four C2 forwarders return the CALLER's eax on their null-device path: Snd::fwdVoice34 (0x484790), Snd::fwdVoiceD0 (0x484a00), Snd::fwdVoiceD4 (0x484a20) test the device at +0x40 and `ret` without writing eax when it is NULL, and Snd::fwdDev58 (0x485240) clears only al. The port returns 0 there (al 0 for fwdDev58 with the upper bytes 0). The oracle judges those rows on their device-path records only (audio_stream.py _C2_KEEP_EAX drops every fourth vector, the null-device ones). Every call site of the four in the exe was not surveyed for a read of eax after the call.
column5: Survey the call sites (re/tools/xref.py) for an eax read after each call; if none reads it, close as harmless.

column4: S4.10: three fixture VM gaps were bridged in audio_stream.py, not in re/tools/fixvm: (1) fixvm.js calls a fixture without its object as `this`, while diff_hook.js calls DIFF_FIXTURES[name]() as a method (c3cc's closeHookC fixtures read this._c3ccCloseC): every fixture function is bound to DIFF_FIXTURES first (BIND_FIXTURES); (2) the emulator's TEB has no DeallocationStack at +0xe0c, which framemask.js reads for the stack's low end (unlinkSound's fixture): ExeKeyRun writes the emulator stack's base there; (3) the VM hands out NativeCallback trap addresses from one counter, so a fixture's callbacks sat at the same address in layouts A, B and C and a region holding a callback pointer read as address-independent: ExeKeyRun makes 0 / 7 / 13 dummy callbacks before the fixture runs (TRAP_SHIFT). With these, 122 of 122 registry keys tie to their CSVs.
column5: Move the three into re/tools/fixvm (S4.1's tool) so other steps' runners get them.

column4: S4.10: the device-present path reaches 74 sound.dll functions with no hooks.csv row (Wave_Device / MultiSound / Midi_Device table slots, 0x3a7c0, 0xaf20, 0xa140 and the field getters and setters). They are registered as `snd.FUN_<va>` with bodies transcribed from their instructions (cited per function in audio_exe.cpp, kSndExtra) and one shared negative control (g_neg_sndExtra); none has a C3 key, so no emulator oracle judges them one by one: their evidence is the device-present run, which completes with 0 host fallbacks and renders non-silent DirectSound buffers, and the stream digest pinned in golden_audio_exe.json ($device). Their names are neutral (FUN_); naming them is a names round.
column5: Name them (re/names sound_*.tsv with evidence), then give each a C3 key or an emulator-oracle key in the S4 census.

column4: S4.10: the exe asks for its course sound effects under `sounds\Golf sfx\` (two spellings in golf_clean.exe: `Golf sfx` and `golf sfx`), while the extracted install original\ holds the directory as `sounds\Golf_Sfx\`. The CD's InstallShield header iso\data1.hdr names it `Golf Sfx` (one occurrence, no `Golf_Sfx`): the extraction (unshield, which also wrote the file groups as `Program_Files_(ENGLISH)`) replaced the space. GameFiles names are case-insensitive on this install but not space / underscore-insensitive, so in original\ those slots read as absent (mmioOpenA fails, the slot gets no device): 178 of 300 slots open in the device-present run. The pinned recordings ran on the same original\, so they hold the same missing files; renaming the directory would change the original's own behaviour against them.
column5: Data of this install, not a port defect. A port install made from the CD keeps the space; original\ stays as it is while the pinned references are in use.
